Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: A user-isolated reflection journal interaction with Gemini multi-turn messages and optional location tag.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry was last updated

messages.description: List of multi-turn chat messages between user and Gemini

isPinned.description: Whether the entry is pinned in the list

location.description: Optional tagged place with coordinates and place name

webhookExportedAt.description: Optional timestamp of last external dispatch

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Designated administrator profile for RBAC access.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator

grantedAt.description: ISO timestamp when access was granted

WebhookConfig.title: WebhookConfig
WebhookConfig.description: User configuration for external webhook dispatch destinations.

id.description: Unique ID of the webhook configuration

webhookUrl.description: Endpoint URL where summaries are dispatched

isEnabled.description: Whether automated summary dispatch is enabled

lastDispatchedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last successful dispatch

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Security and system audit log events.

Milestone.title: Milestone
Milestone.description: Autonomous strategic ambitions, goals, and technical milestones extracted from user reflections.

title.description: Title of the goal or ambition

category.description: Category (e.g., infrastructure, scaling, product, architecture, personal, operations)

targetTimeframe.description: Target timeframe or horizon, e.g., Q3 2026

extractedFromSessionId.description: Optional session ID where this was synthesized

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when milestone was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when milestone was updated

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: User-isolated multi-turn reflection journals and Gemini conversation history.

/users/{userId}/milestones/{milestoneId}.description: User-isolated autonomous dreams, ambitions, and operational milestones.

/users/{userId}/webhookConfigs/{configId.description: User-specific external webhook destinations for reflection summaries.

/admins/{adminId}.description: RBAC collection of validated system administrator identities.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: System-wide immutable security audit log events for administrative monitoring.
